about_the_game:
This is an idle game, not a simulation. All elements are artistically processed and abstracted.

Bugtopia is a relaxing idle game where you can raise and breed your insects, creating a perfect eco-box environment for them. Collect a vast array of decorations and insects, and purchase tools to enhance customization or make your breeding work easier!

🐌 Nearly 100 real-life inspired bugs

  • Breed and cultivate rare species!

  • Unearth fragments to revive ancient bugs.

🌻Hundreds of decorative items with unique appearances

  • Let them grow and transform offline!

  • Customize your very own bug habitat.

⏰More gameplay, more surprises

  • A built-in Pomodoro timer that integrates with the game, serving as both a game and a life/study tool.

  • Various weather settings and white noise to help you relax.

About the Developers

The core trio formed the studio Nocturnal Games after collaborating on multiple GameJams and commercial projects. The planner, Dvion, excels in project management and game design. The introverted artist Menmen is known for her boundless imagination and adorable art style. The programmer, Peecub, can quickly turn creative ideas into game features and specializes in indie and 2D game development. 

We hope to bring you an even better Bugtopia in the future. Stay tuned!

About Publisher

Gcores Publishing is the indie publisher division established by GCORES. In the future, we will continue to bring you outstanding indie games from the BOOOM Game Jam. Follow our publisher page for more updates.

About BOOOM

An indie game brand under GCORES. The BOOOMJAM Game Jam is held twice a year, featuring a three-week, theme-limited game development event. After the development phase, an online playtest festival is held for all players, and the games are showcased at G-Fusion, a large-scale offline game fest held by GCORES.

short_description: In Bugtopia, you can purchase and raise insects to create your own eco-box. Sell them for profit or keep them in the eco-box for continuous idle income. Buy more diverse eco-boxes, decorate them, and enjoy a wonderful summer with the insects!🐛🐌🦋🦟🦗🐜🐝🐞🦂🕷
